description: Source code for an ETC1 texture compression tool that converts PNG images to ETC1 format and vice versa, with options for encoding, decoding, and generating difference images.

methods.name: changeExtension
methods.description: Changes the file extension of a given path.

methods.name: fwrite_big_endian_uint16
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit unsigned integer in big-endian format to a file.

methods.name: fread_big_endian_uint16
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit unsigned integer in big-endian format from a file.

methods.name: read_PNG_File
methods.description: Reads a PNG file into a buffer, extracting width, height, and image data.

methods.name: readPKMFile
methods.description: Reads a PKM (ETC1) file into a buffer, decoding image data.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a PNG image into ETC1 format, optionally creating a difference image.

methods.name: writePNGFile
methods.description: Writes image data to a PNG file.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes an ETC1 PKM file into a PNG image.

methods.name: multipleEncodeDecodeCheck
methods.description: Ensures only one encode/decode operation is specified.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point handling command-line arguments and orchestrating encoding/decoding.
